claims: Troy University is a public university in Troy, Alabama.
Troy University was founded in 1887.
Troy University has a total enrollment of approximately 18,333 students.
Troy University is known as "Alabama's International University".
Troy University has a 93% acceptance rate as of Fall 2023.
Troy University has a 47% graduation rate.
Troy University features 16 Division I athletic teams.
Troy University's athletic teams are called Trojans.
Troy University offers over 290 degree options.
Troy University offers majors in Business, Management, Marketing, and Nursing.
Troy University has a 650-acre main campus.
Troy University has campuses in Dothan, Montgomery, and Phenix City.
Troy University has worldwide service sites.
Troy University enrolls students from over 65 countries.
Troy University competes at the NCAA Division I level.
Troy University competes in the Sun Belt Conference.
Niche ranked Troy University as the 25th Best Online College in America.
Troy University's campus setting includes the Janice Hawkins Cultural Arts Park.
Troy University's net price is approximately $12,504 per year.
Troy University offers specialized support for military, veteran, and family students.
Troy University has approximately 175,000 alumni worldwide
